harness_amendment.issue: Existing metadata orchestration tests assumed Q09 SQL-only evidence could produce full quality acceptance. New direct gate correctly leaves it pending.

limits: Actual compilation/linking and guarded baseline/fixed native execution are still required.
Q09 zero metadata-column boundary cases are local robustness contracts, not fully typed physical plans.
Q20 direct numeric expectations verify routing against the existing KQP cost model; they do not independently validate all CBO mathematics.
Persistent Applied flags are only used for combined and unmatched hints; side hint application copies hint state.
Separate SQL semantic and paired physical/optimizer-quality evidence remains mandatory.
The narrow harness expectation patch requires root review before idle application.
